subject_description: a hulking berserker knight in black spiked plate armor with a horned helm, a torn red cape and a gigantic jagged black greatsword
initial_pose: standing side-on facing right, the gigantic greatsword resting on his right shoulder, blade pointing back
description: a crushing vertical overhead slash to the right: he grips the gigantic greatsword with both hands and raises it high straight up above his head (a clear heavy wind-up, the blade pointing at the sky), holds it for a beat, then takes a big step forward to the right and brings it straight down in a huge vertical arc with BOTH ARMS FULLY STRETCHED OUT in front of him, so the blade tip slams into the ground FAR out to the right, using the empty space on the right side of the picture; he holds the low pose for a beat, then pulls the sword back up and rests it on his shoulder again. Side view facing right in every frame, feet on the same ground line. No effects, no swoosh, no smoke, no dust, no cracks, no motion trails.
